task.subject: Mail retention deletion decision guard domain slice
task.description:
ChangeSet: cs-mail-retention-deletion-decision-guard-fd001-alignment.
Objective: advance P04-connect-pro-mail FD-001 compliance depth by adding a pure mail-domain retention/deletion decision guard that proves tenant-governed mail cannot be deleted when legal hold is active and retention expiry decisions carry deterministic audit data. This is the next narrow mail-domain slice after legal-hold four-eyes and workflow handoff consent guard.
Authority anchors: specs/root-hub-pointers.json -> docs/AGENTS.md -> specs/masterplan.json FD-001 surfaces include mail -> specs/master-plan-sequencing.json -> .omc/plans/milestones/M07-first-tenant/phases/P04-connect-pro-mail/{phase-spec.md,impl-plan.md}. Relevant P04 anchors: legal hold blocks deletion; retention policies; immutable audit log; test_held_message_deletion_blocked; test_retention_expiry; ADR-0208/0215 dual-context and retention/legal hold.
Write scope: ONLY /Users/jasonlee/oyatie-worktrees/fd001-worker1-mail-context-20260520T115222Z/crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs and exact evidence paths evidence/fd001/cs-mail-retention-deletion-decision-guard-fd001-alignment-* plus evidence/multispectrum/cs-mail-retention-deletion-decision-guard-fd001-alignment.json. Do not touch Cargo/root manifests/contracts/registries/adapters/docs or other workers' scopes.
Implementation shape: domain-only, zero I/O, no placeholder/stub. Prefer small types/functions near existing mail legal-hold/guard code: a deletion/retention decision request including tenant/context/mailbox/message identifiers, current time, message received/stored timestamp, retention window, legal_hold_id/count, requester/reason; deterministic refusal errors for Personal context, invalid tenant/message/reason/requester/timestamps/window, active legal hold, and premature retention expiry; deterministic approval/decision/audit receipt for allowed retention-expiry deletion. Keep boundary-first ordering consistent with existing StrictMailLegalHoldGuard/MailWorkflowHandoffGuard semantics.
Required steps: read current lib.rs/tests and one nearby pattern in same file before editing; run planning-closure start gate; run Oya VCS claim for crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs::MailRetentionDeletionDecisionGuard (or exact chosen identifier); implement with focused tests; verify cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo test -p oya-connect-mail-domain -- --nocapture, cargo nextest run -p oya-connect-mail-domain, cargo clippy -p oya-connect-mail-domain --all-targets -- -D warnings, planning-closure, data-class, architecture-boundaries, catalog, dependency-seam, oya git diff --check; Oya VCS verify/done/promote; commit with Lore trailers; transition task complete and report evidence. If a gate is infeasible, record exact blocker and next-best evidence; do not claim done without current evidence.
